summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — a namesake of the Schediuses whom the Iliad names among the Phocians and other allies at Troy.

story.text: Apollodorus names Schedius among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Astylochus and before Antigonus in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
